title: eludite/project/setProperty
description: Edit catalog properties of one project file (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"): the Save of the property pages, one call per project file with every dirty property. The host edits the file with MSBuild's construction model (Microsoft.Build.Construction), preserving formatting: every byte outside the changed elements stays as it was (the encoding, the byte order mark and the line endings too). The condition rule: an unconditioned value goes to the first unconditioned property group (created if none), a conditioned one to the group with the matching condition (created after the last unconditioned group if none), and a value equal to the default removes the element. The inherited rule: a property whose value comes from an imported file such as Directory.Build.props is written only with `override`. When anything was written the host reloads the solution: the generation moves on (the result carries the new one), eludite/solution/status reports the load, and the tree, IntelliSense and the build see the change.

project.description: Absolute path of a project file of the open solution (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`), or the project file that is open as the solution.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the values under. A value that is not the current generation fails with -32801 (ContentModified) and writes nothing: the file may have changed since (another edit, a reload).

edits.description: The edits, applied in order to one in-memory model and written once.

generation.description: The generation after the edit: one more than the request's when the file was written (the host reloaded), else the same.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

written.description: True when the file changed on disk.

value.description: The new value as MSBuild text (a bool's `trueValue` or `falseValue`, a list `;`-separated). A value equal to the default (what the project evaluates to without its own element for this property and condition) removes the element instead; so does null.

configuration.description: The configuration of the conditioned property group to write to. Omitted (with `platform` and `framework` omitted): the unconditioned value (the first unconditioned property group, created after the project's last import of the SDK's props when the project has none).

platform.description: With `configuration`: the group's platform (Visual Studio's `'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|AnyCPU'`). Alone: a platform condition.

framework.description: A target framework condition (`'$(TargetFramework)'=='net8.0'`), combined with the others as Visual Studio writes it (`'$(Configuration)|$(TargetFramework)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|net8.0|AnyCPU'`).

allConfigurations.description: All Configurations: write the unconditioned value and remove this property's elements under configuration, platform or framework conditions (the shell asks first). Not with `configuration`, `platform` or `framework`.

override.description: The value is inherited (Directory.Build.props): write it in the project anyway. Without it, an inherited property is not written and its result says `inherited`.

status.description: written: one element was added or changed; removed: the value equalled the default (or was null) and the element was removed (an empty conditioned property group with it); unchanged: the file already said so; inherited: the property is inherited and `override` was not given, nothing was written.

condition.description: The condition of the group written to; absent for the unconditioned group.

inheritedFrom.description: With `inherited`: the file that defines it.

removedConditions.description: With `allConfigurations`: the conditions whose elements were removed.
